notes:
I can't give one date for Ohio, because each city, township or park district sets its own swim lesson registration day, and the question didn't name a town. The 2027 summer dates I found are mostly not posted yet, so I'd check the town's own recreation page and I haven't guessed any city's morning.

Willoughby's page, for the 2026 season, said resident registration began March 16 and non-resident registration began March 23.

Montgomery's 2026 page said registration began May 8 at 12:00 a.m., and a pool membership was not required. These are last year's dates and show how much towns differ. They are not 2027 dates.
